title: StepResult
description: The result of executing a single workflow step

step_id.description: The identifier of the workflow step

step_name.description: The name of the workflow step

status.description: The execution status of the step

started_at.description: The date and time the step started

completed_at.description: The date and time the step completed

records_processed.description: The number of data records processed by the step

records_failed.description: The number of records that failed processing
